observations.tile: Long blue-and-white paired-stripe canopy covers most of the East 7th return. Red-orange side wall has layered markings, a small corner window, two wheeled bins, a sidewalk cellar cover and a far residential door. Two avenue window stacks; irregular return openings. No front tables visible in these April views.
observations.deli: Seven avenue window stacks; two return stacks sit closer to the pale western panel, with a broad blank brick area to their east. Green-brown hooded lintels. E7 return sign occupies only the west part, red illuminated window lettering, broad blue mural field and layered pale/black/green markings. Monkey has a red MONKEY SUSHI fascia and window strip; Hen has a white script-lettered fascia. Burger red blade and red outdoor structure visible but truck and diners obscure its present glazing. Red dining enclosure is modeled within the retained sidewalk width; current shop glass is partly obscured in the reference. Opaque mural geometry ends before the shop opening.
observations.smoke: Exposed red brick rather than a flat painted coat. Three avenue window stacks; seven return stacks with narrower gaps near the escape. White sign box and raised red letters, blue round corner plaque, product-covered glazing and white category text. Long black poster/mural panels on the return. Yubu red awning and closed shutter visible in September 2024, but furniture/entry obscured by a curbside dining structure.
observations.saifee-corner: Buff brick with dark top staining and darker sills. Two avenue window stacks. Return has both narrow service windows and full-size windows, and two red-brown fire escapes. Entire return has lime-green shop framing, open hardware shelving, pot/soil displays, distinct small canopies, cream SAIFEE HARDWARE sign, corner plants and reed blind at the east end.
observations.saifee-main: Five-story red-brick front, pale tapered lintels, red fire escape and roof railing. Joined dark brown canopy carries SAIFEE hardware & garden, paint branding and small service labels. Dense, varied plant racks and hanging foliage; white/green shop structure and notices.
